Introducing Saved Views, available today for every team on our project management tool. Saved Views let you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you use most, so you never have to rebuild a view from scratch. Set it up once, and return to it instantly whenever you need it.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, deadline, or workflow stage.

Once you build a view you like, you can share it with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective instead of recreating it individually. Shared views keep everyone aligned without extra messages or screenshots explaining filters. This makes standups, reviews, and handoffs faster, since the whole team looks at the same slice of work.

Try it out and see how much time it saves. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
